ARGOS Payroll Reports

From the ORA eTraining module "Building the Project Team: Contractual Hiring and Compensation" (lesson 11 of 15).
ARGOS Reporting: More Accurate Payroll Data
Research Administrators at Morgan should have access to Argos reporting tool's Principal Investigator folder. This folder includes reports that allow users to quickly generate accurate budget screenshots and access more detailed payroll information, including salary and fringe cost data. These reports provide a more complete and user-friendly view of sponsored project personnel expenses than what is typically available through common Banner budget views.
